latin: In per se uiuente apparet primo quaternitas unius, entis, unius entalis, et entis unialis.
latin_note: OCR underscore in 'quaternitas_unius' (farmer1998:16583) read as a word space.
translation: In the self-living there first appears a fourfold: of the one, of being, of the being-like one, and of the one-like being.
translation_note: 'uniale/entale' are scholastic coinages (unius entalis, entis unialis) with no classical sense; rendered 'being-like one' and 'one-like being'. 'per se uiuens' rendered 'the self-living'; Farmer's note identifies it with the 'per se animal' (farmer1998:16622).
